body.statement: For the unequal six-block population with \(r=(1,1,1,3,3,3)\), \(n=12\), and \(\alpha=1/4\), the three size-three coordinates cap and the three size-one coordinates do not. Explicitly, \(\lambda_\alpha=\sqrt{24(\log4-3/8)}\), \(\omega_{1/4}=3/4+\sqrt{(\log4-3/8)/24}\approx0.9553\), and the subset retaining only size-one blocks gives \(\rho_0\le3/4+1/\sqrt{24}\approx0.9541\).
body.justification: The numerical exhibit exposes the cap threshold and the near-matching trimming certificate in a reproducible unequal-block instance.
body.gap: An equal-block substitution has only one breakpoint and therefore cannot reproduce simultaneous capped and uncapped coordinates.
body.consumer: The software diagnostic uses this instance as a unit test for sorting, multiplier solution, and trimming output.
